name_input: HUF INDIA PVT LTD; HUF INDIA PVT LTD; HUF INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export record retrieved. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/huf-india-pvt-ltd returned only a JavaScript shell: 'Shipments available for HUF INDIA PVT LTD, refreshed daily' — 0 shipment rows actually rendered (source counter: page claims India customs data back to 2008; rows seen: 0). Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read from any source.
domestic_evidence: Only corporate-group presence is documented, not a supply transaction: huf-group.com (https://www.huf-group.com/en/) lists 'Tal. Khed Pune, India' among its 17 R+D & manufacturing sites — this is a plant location statement, not a GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender or contract. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP award, no annual-report India split was retrievable (Zaubacorp and TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403).
note: Registry and catalogue sources were out of scope and mostly blocked (403/JS challenge), so no shipment-level evidence was obtained either way. The company appears to be the Indian manufacturing arm of the German automotive access-systems group Huf Hülsbeck & Fürst (declared HS 870899 = other parts/accessories for motor vehicles, consistent with the group's lock sets, latches and door-handle systems), but this is an inference from the group website, not a verified shipment. No export or domestic supply record was seen: следов поставок не найдено в доступных источниках. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN verified. Status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' only because the trade-data platforms were inaccessible, not because records were checked and found empty.
